Georgian Alphabet

33 Letters of Georgian Script

Georgian has its own unique alphabet with 33 letters. Each letter has a consistent pronunciation, making it easier to learn than English spelling!

Learning Tips

  • Practice pronunciation daily - Georgian is phonetic
  • Learn the 33-letter Georgian alphabet gradually
  • Focus on practical phrases for daily situations
